channel.title: A problem with alot of scp articles.
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "A problem with alot of scp articles."

item.title: Re: A problem with alot of scp articles.
item.content:encoded:
SCP-914 was written over 12 years ago, making it among the earliest work on the site. The quality of the writing may not be up to current site standards, but it's kept around due to its overwhelming popularity, which is valid even if some of that popularity is based in nostalgia. The original author is rarely on the site anymore, so it's unlikely to see edits to bring it up to current writing standards or tastes.

If you haven't done so, I recommend you read some more recent work, to see how articles may look different these days. Top Rated New Pages, accessible from the side bar menu, is a great place to start. Or, if you like the subjects of the SCPs, but not the article format, try reading some tales instead.

item.title: A problem with alot of scp articles.
item.content:encoded:
Input: 1 chimp (setting: Fine)

Output: [DATA EXPUNGED]

Input: 1 chimp (setting: Rough)

Output: Badly mutilated corpse, showing signs of crushing and cutting with high heat

Those are lines from SCP-914. Why would the SCP use 'chimp' instead of chimpanzee?
A lot of SCPs are structured like poorly-written wikipedia articles, instead of actual scientific reports.
Censored information makes no sense either, why would it be censored in the first place?
Honestly, draft-reviewers should be more informed of things like this.
